rationale: The blind translation accurately reconstructs the exact mathematical core of the row-scaling condition, including theta, dyadic dependence on the row infinity norm, endpoint strictness, and the equivalent entrywise scaled-row bounds. It nevertheless changes the semantic object from a component of a mixed-precision matrix-multiplication algorithm into a standalone exact-real construction: the B and column side, full diagonal scaling computation, rounding and accumulation model, exceptional-value assumptions, and format interpretation of fmax and Fmax are absent. Conversely, the translation generalizes the domain to arbitrary positive real bounds and fixes a Skolemized construction not stated by the paper. The two statements therefore do not imply one another as complete results.
